test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sector of a circle has a radius of 18 cm and a central angle of 125°. What will be its approximate perimeter? (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Radius = 18 cm

Central angle = 125° 

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of sector of a circle = θ/360° × 2πr + 2r

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6791927b953aa209c8acacb3fe23db560d40cb118641a23d86c5c1d50347c19c.png] 

According to the question:

Perimeter of sector of a circle = θ/360° × 2πr + 2r

⇒ (125/360 × 2 × 22/7 × 18 + 2 × 18)

⇒ (25/72 × 44/7 × 18 + 36)

⇒ (275/7 + 36)

⇒ (275 + 252)/7

⇒ 527/7

⇒ 75.28 cm ~ 75.3 cm

**∴ The required perimeter is 75.3 cm.**
